During the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serroco]] was represented in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] by a '''senator'''. The [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] ended with the practice of people issuing false tornado warnings to the planet's native [[Stereb]], from a [[Unidentified watchstation|watchstation]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]].
